KL.direction: KL(student || teacher) = mean_i sum_k student_prob[i,k] * (log student_prob[i,k] - log soft[i,k]) (student-first, dung mission + v101 student_spec).
KL.formula_torch: student_logprob = log_softmax(student_logits, dim=1); teacher_prob = clamp(soft_targets, 1e-12, 1.0); kl_per_row = (exp(student_logprob) * (student_logprob - log(teacher_prob))).sum(1); KL = kl_per_row.mean() tren soft-subset (train) / val-soft-subset (monitor).
KL.weight_kl_why: KL la so hang CHINH (ep attention bat chuoc phan bo SSM thay vi tu hoc order tu label tho).

entropy_floor.formula: p = softmax(logits); H = -(p*log p).sum(1); ent = 1.0 * mean(relu(2.2 - H)^2) (train-batch, causal train-only). Inactive khi healthy (H>=floor).

ranking_on_hard.applies_to: student_logits (n,16) free units vs hard labels ch0 (percent, zeros giu).
ranking_on_hard.formula: ListNet-listwise (VERBATIM v96 listnet_loss logic, tau 1.0%): target = softmax(realized/1.0); logp = log_softmax(logits/1.0); loss = -(target*logp).sum(1).mean() tren full train-batch.
ranking_on_hard.weight_lambda_rank_why: 0.1 THAP (pre-spec): duoi v101 suggest 0.1-0.25 low-end + duoi xa v96 PRIMARY 2.0 va v38 phu 0.5; soft-target da chua order nen rank chi la ap luc nho giu thu tu, khong dan loss gay collapse.
